description: Logical three-way merge corpus shared by logical-merge.ts and kb-local logical_merge.rs. Each side builds base/main/proposal trees (the managed .gitignore = `gitignore`, index.md = `index`, `docs`, `bulk` documents bulk/dNNNN.md = "x\n", the canonical manifest of `assets`), merges with the line merges given (absent or null = the lines clash) and the recorded conflicts (choice = a document's text or an asset entry), with repository limits enforced, and must produce `expect` exactly (`documents` omits index.md and the bulk documents; `bulkDocuments` counts the bulk documents kept). Regenerate both sides together.

cases.name: every duplicated document id is reported
same-path asset clash keeps the PR entry
clean line merge and a clashing one
a line merge that duplicates an id is a conflict
recorded conflict with a saved choice stays reported
the file limit falls back the latest additions
the file limit: main grew too
